entries.subject: DAMIT 4383: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-4383.txt. Model 4383, version 2019-07-19, pole (291°, 12°), period 21.0401 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Franco & Pilcher (2019), A new lightcurve and spin-shape model for 46 Hestia
entries.finding: [Franco & Pilcher (2019), A new lightcurve and spin-shape model for 46 Hestia](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MPBu...46..140F) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 120.62 ± 1.53 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 46 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Resolved-model surveys: body-specific candidate not established
entries.finding: The imported survey cites Hanuš 2017, Viikinkoski 2017 and Vernazza 2021 without identifying a selected product for this body. The current DAMIT reference join does not bind selected model 4383 to those surveys. This does not prove that no resolved model exists elsewhere; a body-specific candidate and its release must be identified before the entry can count as included.
entries.revisitWhen: A target row, supplementary model or release URL from one of these surveys establishes a concrete candidate and permits comparison with the selected shape.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 4384, pole ['110', '7'], [Model 4384](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/4384) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 4384: pole (110°, 7°), 21.0401 h, version 2019-07-19. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Hestia whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 10 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.938 at 462 nm, 1.039 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3e3c3a in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.6% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 1.5%), from NEOWISE (Nugent et al. 2016, AJ 152, 63; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
